Container.Name: LoggiFly
Container.Overview:
LoggiFly is a lightweight, real-time Docker container log monitor that scans for predefined keywords or regex patterns and sends instant notifications through your favorite channels (via ntfy or Apprise to 100+ services including Discord, Telegram, Slack, and webhooks).
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]Keyword & Regex Detection:[/b] Match plain text keywords, complex regular expressions, and multi-line log entries. - [b]Instant Alerts:[/b] Native direct support for ntfy (topics, priority, tags) and Apprise (100+ notification providers). - [b]Container Actions:[/b] Automatically trigger a container restart or clean stop when critical error patterns or loops are detected. - [b]Log Context Attachments:[/b] Automatically attach log excerpts to notifications for rapid debugging. - [b]Hot Reloading:[/b] Changes made to [inline]config.yaml[/inline] are automatically detected and reloaded without restarting the container. - [b]Remote Hosts & Proxies:[/b] Compatible with direct Docker socket mounts or Docker Socket Proxies (Tecnativa, 11notes).
[b]Initial Setup:[/b] 1. [b]Quickstart (Environment Variables):[/b] You can monitor containers immediately by filling out the [b]CONTAINERS[/b], [b]GLOBAL_KEYWORDS[/b], and [b]NTFY_URL[/b] or [b]APPRISE_URL[/b] fields. 2. [b]Advanced Setup (config.yaml):[/b] For per-container rules, regex filters, and actions, place your [inline]config.yaml[/inline] inside [inline]/mnt/user/appdata/loggifly[/inline]. See documentation for examples: [url=https://clemcer.github.io/loggifly/guide/config/]Configuration Guide[/url]. 3. [b]Permissions:[/b] The Docker socket is mounted as read-only by default. If you use container actions (restart/stop), change the Docker Socket volume mode to [inline]rw[/inline].
[b]Credits & Support:[/b] - LoggiFly is created by [b]clemcer[/b] ([url=https://github.com/clemcer/LoggiFly]GitHub[/url] | [url=https://clemcer.github.io/loggifly/]Documentation[/url]). Support the developer on [url=https://ko-fi.com/clemcer]Ko-fi[/url] or [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/clemcer]Buy Me a Coffee[/url]. - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.

Config.Name: AppData / Config Directory
Config.Description: Directory to store config.yaml for fine-grained rules, keywords, and notification settings.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Host Docker socket to stream container logs. Set to 'rw' if you configure container actions (restart/stop).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps in notifications (e.g. Europe/Amsterdam, UTC).

Config.Name: Monitored Containers (Quickstart)
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated container names to monitor (e.g. 'vaultwarden,nextcloud'). Can be omitted if using config.yaml.

Config.Name: Global Keywords (Quickstart)
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated keywords to alert on across monitored containers. Can be omitted if using config.yaml.

Config.Name: ntfy Server URL (Quickstart)
Config.Description: Optional ntfy server address (e.g. https://ntfy.sh or self-hosted http://192.168.1.50:80).

Config.Name: ntfy Token
Config.Description: Optional access token for protected ntfy topics.

Config.Name: Apprise URL (Quickstart)
Config.Description: Optional Apprise notification URL for Discord, Telegram, Slack, etc. (e.g. discord://webhook_id/webhook_token).

Config.Name: Strict Config Validation
Config.Description: Refuse to start if unknown or misspelled fields are found in config.yaml (true / false).
